title: Crown Prince Hans-Adam's Armageddon agenda, 1994 meeting

tellings.quote: is that we want the public to hate the aliens so bad that we can have an interplanetary war so that we'll have Armageddon. So Christ will return. I'm quoting.

plain: The UFO activist Steven Greer says that at a 1994 meeting at the Pierre Hotel in New York with Hans-Adam II of Liechtenstein, he was told of an agenda to make "the public hate the aliens so bad that we can have an interplanetary war so that we'll have Armageddon. So Christ will return," adding to Michels, "I'm quoting." Greer tells it as someone who was there, and links the meeting to the alien-abduction researchers Budd Hopkins, John Mack and David Jacobs and to the philanthropist Laurance Rockefeller; if true, it would mean powerful people wanted to turn the public against aliens for religious ends.
